decision_rules.numerical_only_or_failed_semantics: Consider the already-prepared SVD500 reference-CE forecasting study for its distinct numerical claim. Do not claim interpretable components or unrestricted behavioral prediction from numerical accuracy.
decision_rules.no_supported_positive: Deliver the completed evidence and limitations. Do not choose further variants simply to obtain a positive result.
